analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 130 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。
中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Qwen / 通义千问、腾讯元宝 / 混元、DeepSeek。代表性变化包括 《DeepSeek 故障近5小时,补偿方案 公布》、《DeepSeek 发布 补偿通知》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 12 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

items.title: Magnetar brings faster, simpler, quantum-ready zero-knowledge proofs
items.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs can verify computing results without rerunning workloads or exposing sensitive data. Magnetar helps bring them into the mainstream with support for standard programming languages, major speed gains, and quantum-resistant security. The post Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.summary: OpenAI 的通用推理模型找到一族新的点集构造，证明单位距离对数可以达到 n 的 1+δ 次方，从而推翻长期流行的 n 的 1+o(1) 上界猜想。证明已由外部数学家检查，并有公开证明 PDF 与多位数学家的伴随评论。

items.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
items.summary: StudentSim is a research system for evaluating and improving AI tutoring tools before they are tested with learners. It models how individuals may engage with tutors, giving feedback to improve tutor performance across subjects like chess, writing, and mathematics. The post Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
items.summary: Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions. The post Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.title: Rethinking Anonymity Claims in Synthetic Data Generation: A Model-Centric Privacy Attack Perspective
items.summary: Training generative machine learning models to produce synthetic tabular data has become a popular approach for enhancing privacy in data sharing. As this typically involves processing sensitive personal information, releasing either the trained model or generated synthetic datasets can still pose privacy risks. Yet, recent research, commercial deployments, and privacy regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) largely assess anonymity at the level of an individual dataset.

items.title: Going Faster: Privacy-Preserving Shortest Paths from Start to End
items.summary: Finding shortest paths in graphs is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem with numerous applications, e. g., in graph centrality measures, computational biology, and business process analysis. To address privacy constraints in such applications, Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) protocols can compute the lengths of shortest paths on secret-shared graphs. Many such protocols have been proposed in the past, but they only compute the lengths of the shortest paths and not the paths themselves.

items.title: Verifiable Blind Pseudonymization via Polymorphic Encryption Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
items.summary: Pseudonymization is a basic technique for privacy protection, limiting identifiability and linkability of data. Data can be pseudonymized blindly, i.e., while being end-to-end encrypted, using the Polymorphic Encryption and Pseudonymization (PEP) framework. This means that the party performing pseudonymization does not see the values of pseudonyms and cannot determine if two (encrypted) pseudonyms belong to each other, ensuring confidentiality and unlinkability. The pseudonymizing party can, however, unnoticeably corrupt any data being exchanged. This violates integrity. items.summary: Tor is a privacy-enhancing technology that enables anonymous communication by leveraging onion routing. items.summary: In this paper, we study the trust assumptions underlying key generation in functional encryption (FE) schemes, as well as the information leakage that can arise from the use of functional decryption keys.
